Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misclassified physical weathering, rejecting “ice fracturing a stone” (a classic example of mechanical weathering via frost wedging) as erosion and instead chose “a bulldozer pushing soil,” which describes transport/erosion rather than in-place weathering of rock.
